data.exact_reserve_text: The improved performance is credited to the claims ratio improving significantly. This resulted from releases in reserves from 2017, 2015 and prior years, where claims from these years have developed favourably in the year as the impact of the remediation and improvements are starting to emerge.

prior_year_events.impact_description: The estimate of gross and net provision was affected by the change of Ogden discount rate from 2.5% to -0.75%.

named_events.loss_description: a small number of large fire and theft losses in Q2 & Q3 and a single abnormally large loss have seen the accident year performance worsen against the long-term average

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross prior year reserve release of GBP 90.66 million, primarily driven by favourable claims development from the 2017, 2015, and prior underwriting years. This positive movement is attributed to the impact of remediation and improvements. The Ogden discount rate change in 2017 from 2.5% to -0.75% also affected the estimates of gross and net provisions.

data.data_quality_notes: The 'Movement in prior accident year's provision for claims outstanding' note on page 15 provides a net release of GBP 13.213m. However, the gross prior year development of -GBP 90.660m was calculated from the gross claims development triangle on page 11, excluding the '2010 and prior' aggregate column and the two most recent underwriting years (2017 and 2018), as per instructions to prioritize gross figures from the triangle when a gross movement note is not available.
